question: Does a frozen simple coordinate tag on exact ECCp-131 enrich true four-summand small-x relations over matched nulls and random bases while admitting subquadratic qualifying-pair enumeration?

claims.text: The exact planted ECCp-131 four-sum is recovered by the same pair-table root path used for the published target probe.
The selected coordinate filter has held-out relation enrichment beyond its matched null and random-base controls.
claims.if_supported: candidate passes the frozen statistical and enumeration gates at the measured ECCp-131 sizes
claims.if_not_supported: no qualifying filter exists in the frozen candidate family; other predicates remain open

claims.text: Bounded exact ECCp-131 relation generation, modular rank, and published-target descent counts are reported without treating a null as a logarithm.

hypotheses.statement: A pre-add coordinate tag may retain more true four-sum relations than its null density and can reject pair candidates before an elliptic-curve addition.
hypotheses.mechanism: small-x coordinate structure could couple endpoint arithmetic to the rational addition law in a way absent from a scalar-random base

predictions.minimum_effect: 95% lower confidence bound above zero and not explained by the random-base arm

data_seen.measured: prior exact arity-2/3 null relation counts; no representation-tag sweep

arms.description: exact ECCp-131 small-x base, coordinate-filter sweep
matched distinct scalar-derived points in the exact ECCp-131 subgroup
bit-identical re-evaluation of the selected small-x winner on the frozen held-out cohort
known four-summand target recovered by exact signed pair-table lookup
pair features matched to a target coordinate from an independent four-sum sample

positive.expected_detection: exact witness recovered and group identity reverified

null_population.description: same pair-feature distribution with an independent target coordinate
null_population.generator: cyclically rotate the target coordinates by one sample after generating the fixed cohort
null_population.why_n: at width eight this gives about 32 expected null hits, the preregistered eligibility floor

factors.name: cohort
factors.how: disjoint seeds and no test-driven selection

factors.name: relation_label
factors.how: every configuration is evaluated on both matched labels

factors.name: seed
factors.how: explicit frozen list; independent train/test/base streams

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: primary metrics are exact counts; local clocks are invalid and descriptive

factors.name: host
factors.how: host facts retained; clocks require L2 and are invalid locally

randomization.arm_order_reason: decisive outputs are deterministic counts, not clocks; test data are generated before either arm is scored

instance_sampling.rule: uniform signed base indices with rejected infinities; null target is a one-position cyclic rotation

blinding.how: configuration selection is mechanical and test labels are never read during training selection

power.note: 8192 held-out relation and null samples resolve a null rate of 1/256 with about 32 expected hits; training configurations below 32 null hits are ineligible

preflight_runtime.measured_on: not yet measured; conservative source-level estimate

primary.name: held-out log2 enrichment
primary.definition: log2 of Jeffreys-smoothed true-relation hit rate divided by independent-null hit rate for the training-selected configuration

primary.name: qualifying pairs
primary.definition: number of endpoint pairs admitted by the selected tag before an EC group addition, or all pairs for post-add tags

secondary.name: root witnesses
secondary.definition: exact four-sum witnesses recovered by the signed pair table and reverified

secondary.name: natural relation rows
secondary.definition: exact scalar-derived rows found by ic prime for each arity and phase

placement.instance_type: current x86_64 executor; exact host facts recorded at runtime

stopping_rules.rule: fixed B values, fixed train/test sizes, and complete candidate grid; then stop
do not launch cloud work while the USD 25 budget remainder is unknown or exhausted

invalidation_rules: positive root control fails group-law replay
training and held-out seeds or samples overlap
a local clock is used for a performance claim
an unavailable exact-width F4 or F5 phase is reported as measured

decision_rule.text: Support requires the training-selected winner to have held-out enrichment whose conservative 95% lower ratio exceeds 1, no matched random-base explanation, and a concrete subquadratic qualifying-pair enumerator. Otherwise report no_qualifying_filter_in_frozen_family.
decision_rule.threshold: lower confidence ratio > 1; random-base control below it; enumeration O(B + output) or otherwise o(B^2)
decision_rule.statistic: held-out relation/null rate ratio and exact enumeration classification
decision_rule.interval: ratio of Wilson bounds (relation lower / null upper), 95%

graphs: held-out log2 enrichment by base design and B with zero line

inadmissible: selecting a configuration on held-out data
changing seeds, sample counts, candidate grid, or minimum-null support after seeing results
reading a bounded null as a proof about all factor bases or as a recovered logarithm
claiming an end-to-end speedup from local timing

literature.ref: Galbraith, Mathematics of Public Key Cryptography (2018), pp. 283-284
literature.claim: five-property generalized Wagner checklist and representation-aware four-sum heuristic
Wagner needs a quotient/filter compatible with partial sums; no such generic quotient exists in a prime-order EC group
prior B256-B1024 arity-2/3 exact probes produced zero natural rows; pair support is the bottleneck
